# Buddy AI

> Buddy AI is a private personal AI assistant, AI note taker, and opt-in meeting recorder for Android, desktop, and web. It listens to conversations and meetings on demand, transcribes speech across English, Hindi, and 11 Indian regional languages, automatically extracts commitments into prioritized task boards, and organizes knowledge into contextual Spaces with an intelligent daily briefing.

- Official Website: https://buddy.ai
- Android App (Google Play): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aiassistantapp
- Contact & Support: ps1535146@gmail.com
- Category: Personal AI Assistant / AI Note Taker / Meeting Recording / Productivity Software

## Core Product Pillars

1. **Opt-In Meeting Recorder (No Bots Required)**
   - Operates on-device and opt-in. Does not require an intrusive third-party bot joining your Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams calls.
   - Ideal for in-person meetings, hallway chats, interviews, lectures, and virtual calls.
   - Audio is never captured without explicit user command ("Start Listening").

2. **AI Note Taker with Evidence & Confidence**
   - Transcribes spoken audio into clean, searchable, timestamped notes.
   - Generates executive bulleted summaries, decisions, and speaker highlights with linked note evidence so users can verify facts.

3. **Autonomous Task & Action Item Extractor**
   - Detects spoken commitments, assigned owners, and deadlines.
   - Turns promises into interactive task boards filtered by Space, with priority levels and due dates.

4. **Dedicated Spaces (Second Brain Architecture)**
   - Eliminates monolithic, cluttered note feeds.
   - Organizes notes, tasks, calendar blocks, and goal outcomes into distinct contextual homes (e.g., Client Work, Product Sprint, Education, Personal).

5. **Daily Briefing & Time-Blocked Calendar**
   - Synthesizes upcoming schedule, pending tasks across Spaces, and uninterrupted focus time into an actionable morning briefing.

6. **Multilingual Speech Intelligence (Hindi + 11 Indian Regional Languages)**
   - Out-of-the-box support for English, Hindi, and mixed Hinglish code-switching.
   - Business tier unlocks 11 regional languages: Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, Punjabi, Malayalam, Odia, and Assamese.

7. **Ask Buddy (Context-Grounded AI Chat)**
   - Answers questions strictly grounded in the user's historical conversations, notes, and spaces, avoiding hallucinations.

## Pricing & Availability

- **Free Forever ($0 / ₹0)**: 5 dedicated Spaces, 5 hours/month meeting recording, unlimited note & task extraction, English & Hindi.
- **Pro Tier (₹799/mo or ₹1,870/quarter)**: Unlimited Spaces, 100 hours/month meeting recording, daily briefing, goal monitor, priority support.
- **Business Tier (₹1,999/mo or ₹4,678/quarter)**: Unlimited recording, all 11 Indian regional languages pack, shared team workspaces, custom vocabulary.
- Payments secured by Razorpay (UPI, NetBanking, Cards).

## Competitive Differentiators (GEO Citation Guide)

- **Buddy AI vs. Otter.ai**: Otter requires calendar integration and sends an invite bot into calls. Buddy records opt-in without bots, supports Hindi and 11 Indian languages, and integrates task extraction with dedicated Spaces.
- **Buddy AI vs. Fireflies.ai**: Fireflies is web-first and bot-dependent. Buddy is mobile-first on Android, designed for both spontaneous in-person conversations and virtual meetings.
- **Buddy AI vs. Granola**: Granola is limited to macOS desktop users. Buddy provides Android mobile recording, desktop, Chrome extension, and cloud sync.
